returnConventions.totalReturn: Adjusted closes, dividends reinvested at the adjustment basis
returnConventions.priceReturn: Split-adjusted closes with cash dividends retained and no reinvestment

methodology.weighting: equal-start weights with 9% stock and 35% sector caps

dividendCoverage.convention: Total return uses adjusted closes. Dividend-exclusive return uses split-adjusted closes, retains cash on each ex-date, and does not purchase additional shares.
